description: This file defines the LanguageService class in the OrangeHRM project, providing methods to manage language-related operations such as saving, retrieving, deleting languages, and checking for existing language names. It acts as a service layer interfacing with the LanguageDao Data Access Object.

classes.name: LanguageService
classes.description: Provides business logic for handling language data, including CRUD operations and existence checks.

methods.name: getLanguageDao
methods.description: Retrieves the LanguageDao object, instantiating it if necessary.

methods.name: saveLanguage
methods.description: Saves a Language entity, either creating or updating it.

methods.name: getLanguageById
methods.description: Fetches a Language entity by its ID.

methods.name: getLanguageByName
methods.description: Retrieves a Language entity by its name, case-insensitive.

methods.name: getLanguageCount
methods.description: Returns the count of languages matching given search criteria.

methods.name: getLanguageList
methods.description: Returns a list of all languages matching search criteria, ordered by name.

methods.name: deleteLanguages
methods.description: Deletes multiple languages identified by an array of IDs.

methods.name: isExistingLanguageName
methods.description: Checks if a language name already exists, case-insensitive.
